title: quercus dumosa var. linearis
intro: Quercus dumosa var. linearis, commonly known as the Himalayan oak, is a plant species within the Quercus dumosa complex, native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Quercus dumosa var. linearis include astringency, anti-diarrheal, and anti-asthmatic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions, as well as to fully elucidate its bioactive constituents.
